# Clean Roots Arbor Care

> Professional tree care services in Buffalo, NY. Licensed, bonded, and insured arborists offering tree trimming, removal, stump grinding, land clearing, and 24/7 emergency storm cleanup.

- [Tree Removal](https://clean-roots-arbor-care.web.app/#services)
- [Stump Grinding & Removal](https://clean-roots-arbor-care.web.app/#services)
- [24/7 Emergency Storm Cleanup](https://clean-roots-arbor-care.web.app/#services)
- [Land & Lot Clearing](https://clean-roots-arbor-care.web.app/#services)
- [Tree Health & Consultation](https://clean-roots-arbor-care.web.app/#services)
